edits.description: Reconstructed the complete remaining Font Manager interval. Preserved the original descriptive header, applicable comments, record equates, and data tables. Mapped the older FontMgrPatch.a bodies to the ROM despite their changed order.

Emitted 861 MC68000 instructions with symbolic routine and branch targets. The evidence pairs 452 instructions with corresponding source operations and records 409 instructions restored from the ROM alone. Pairings describe correspondence; they do not establish identical original encodings or historical labels.

Restored the four direct input-record comparisons and the space-extra shortcut. A failed resource load retries through FMSwapFontCore with a copied input record and family zero. The ROM saves registers without the later A6 stack frame.

Restored the older cache scan described in the patch history. It stops at the first match, empty entry, purged entry, or list end. The ROM exchanges the selected handle with WidthTabHandle and changes purge bits directly. It stores FOND flags in the high byte of WidthListHand.

Restored the integral, font-fractional, and family-fractional width loops. Callers add style extra before ScaleD0. The ROM uses WidthPtr directly, updates cached widths by the change in style extra, and scales the space-extra adjustment separately.

Restored MyFixMul and MyFixRatio, whose names remain in the source history. Their bodies come from ROM instructions. They skip selected unit, equal-operand, and integer-factor calculations before invoking the fixed-point traps.

Restored the older size substitution, font-neighborhood search, and style selection. FindClosest starts with a maximum difference of 127. The family-width search requires an exact style match. The ROM retains the earlier signed scale comparisons and omitted later rounding adjustments.
Selected the non-patch SetNewDevice and SetScreenDevice bodies. The patch source explicitly names their Mac Plus ROM addresses, $40EE82 and $40EEAC.
Retained 118 bytes of original data definitions: FPointOne, StyleWeights, ScreenStyleTab, and Theft. No instruction uses a raw data placeholder.
Made branch widths and PC addressing explicit. Used source field names when their values matched the ROM operands. Defined external entry points at InValWidths, GetFOND, and BuildCharTable.

Kept complete applicable original comment paragraphs and corresponding instruction comments. Omitted superseded patch notes, comments that depend on later behavior, and incomplete comments attached to changed operations. Removed later patch markers from three retained comments and marked authored explanations as reconstruction notes.
Together with FontMgrInit.a and FontMgr.a, this file closes the continuous Font Manager span from $40E5E4 through $40F455. LoadSeg begins at $40F456.

verification.method: Called Reconstruction/Tools/verify.py verify_module in an independent temporary directory. The verifier assembled for MC68000, linked at the ROM address, checked entry points and relocations, and compared every emitted byte.
verification.scope: The entire emitted span matches the ROM. MPW assembly has not been run. The bytes establish machine behavior; source pairings and inferred labels remain reconstruction judgments.
